basis: Dehydrodolichyl diphosphate synthase 5; LRC by whole-mount HCR in Ath/Esa/Sir/Spa and conserved LRC gene in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun); LRC cluster marker in Coate et al. 2020 Front Genet. LRC/columella boundary in Wang is soft: check columella expression.

SKU5-similar multicopper oxidase; LRC-enriched (Coate et al. 2020 Front Genet; Shahan et al. 2022 Dev Cell) and conserved LRC gene in 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun). No in situ. Same row as arabidopsis_root.tsv.

Pyruvate orthophosphate dikinase; Shahan 2022 columella marker, the only one of 17 known columella markers specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun). No in situ; Wang columella shares genes with LRC.
ACC oxidase 4 (EFE); Shahan 2022 columella marker, columella-specific in Ath/Sir/Spa but not Esa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2). No in situ.

Proline-rich protein-like (UniProt Q9FFG5: MOP10, AtPRPL1); trichoblast by whole-mount HCR in Ath/Esa/Sir/Spa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun). SD2 cites "Liu 2020 Mol Plant 14", which is the rice root atlas (Liu et al. 2021), so no independent Arabidopsis cluster evidence.
RSL class II bHLH that sets root-hair growth; trichoblast cluster marker (Denyer et al. 2019 Dev Cell) and trichoblast-specific in Ath/Sir/Spa, not Esa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun).
COBRA-like protein required for root-hair tip growth; trichoblast-specific in Ath/Sir/Spa, not Esa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun); in arabidopsis_root.tsv.
LJRHL1-like bHLH acting in root-hair development; Shahan 2022 marker, trichoblast-specific in Ath/Sir/Spa, not Esa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun). No in situ in these studies.
Class III peroxidase; one of only 4 conserved atrichoblast genes in 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD3). No in situ; Wang atrichoblast markers also light LRC/columella.
Class III peroxidase; conserved atrichoblast gene in 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD3). No in situ; same caveat as PER69.
Extensin-like protein; cortex by whole-mount HCR in Ath/Esa/Sir/Spa and conserved cortex gene (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun).

Apoplastic aspartyl protease; conserved cortex gene in 4 spp; HCR marks the whole (single-layer) cortex in Ath/Esa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun Fig 4). In Sir/Spa it is inner-layer biased (see Inner_Cortex).

HCR of Si-s1384-01650 marks the inner of two cortex layers in S. irio, and the Spa ortholog is inner-biased (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun Fig 4; up in S. irio middle subpopulation, SD5). Only for species with two cortex layers.
Uclacyanin 1; endodermis by whole-mount HCR in Ath/Esa/Sir/Spa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun) and endodermis cluster marker in Wendrich et al. 2020 Science.
Casparian strip membrane domain protein; endodermis-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun); in arabidopsis_root.tsv.
Casparian strip membrane domain protein; endodermis-specific in Ath/Esa/Sir, not called in Spa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2); in arabidopsis_root.tsv.
Casparian strip membrane domain protein; conserved endodermis gene in 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD3); in arabidopsis_root.tsv.
Casparian strip membrane domain protein 5; conserved endodermis gene in 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD3).
MYB TF activating Casparian strip genes; endodermis-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun); in arabidopsis_root.tsv.
Peroxidase required for Casparian strip lignification; endodermis-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun); in arabidopsis_root.tsv.

Aliphatic suberin feruloyl transferase (HHT1) of suberizing endodermis, so maturation-zone only; endodermis cluster marker in Wendrich et al. 2020 Science and endodermis-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2).
GRAS TF for endodermis/cortex specification (also QC); endodermis-specific only in Ath/Esa in Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2, not called in Sir/Spa. In arabidopsis_root.tsv.

SIAR1/UMAMIT amino acid exporter (UniProt: WAT1-related protein At1g44800); pericycle by whole-mount HCR in Ath/Esa/Sir/Spa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun) and Shahan et al. 2022 Dev Cell pericycle marker. No xylem-/phloem-pole split; check procambium.
bHLH TF; conserved pericycle gene in 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD3). No in situ.
Auxin influx carrier; conserved procambium gene, but HCR in 4 spp is stele-wide in the root tip (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun), so it does not separate procambium from pericycle or young vasculature.
SISTER OF APL (PHL12, MYB-related); phloem by whole-mount HCR in Ath/Esa/Sir/Spa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun) and phloem cluster marker in Coate et al. 2020 Front Genet. SE vs CC not resolved.
MYB-related TF required for phloem (SE and CC) identity; phloem-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun); in arabidopsis_root.tsv.
Companion-cell sucrose/H+ symporter; conserved phloem gene in 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD3), where it marks the CC part of the merged Phloem label. Same gene as arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.

Plasma-membrane H+-ATPase energizing phloem loading in companion cells; phloem cluster marker in Coate et al. 2020 Front Genet and phloem-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2). CC localization from earlier reporter work not re-checked here.

Fasciclin-like arabinogalactan protein of secondary-wall cells; xylem by whole-mount HCR in Ath/Esa/Sir/Spa (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun) and xylem cluster marker in Denyer et al. 2019 Dev Cell. Not the Nb-DE pick removed from the skill tables.
Secondary-wall xylan xylosyltransferase (irx9 collapsed xylem); xylem-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2); in arabidopsis_root.tsv.
DUF579 protein needed for secondary-wall xylan (irx15 irregular xylem); Shahan 2022 xylem marker, xylem-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2).
GAUT12 galacturonosyltransferase for secondary-wall xylan (irx8); Shahan 2022 xylem marker, xylem-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2).
Xylan glucuronosyltransferase of secondary walls (also fibers); xylem cluster marker in Coate et al. 2020 Front Genet, xylem-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2).
bHLH TF; Shahan 2022 xylem marker, xylem-specific in all 4 spp (Wang et al. 2026 Nat Commun SD2). No in situ.
